title: The world answers back
prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame. Preserve its exact monochrome palette, physical hardware, framing and material texture. Minimal black-and-white 16mm film, natural grain and subtle optical softness. Motion must be physically plausible, very small and deliberate. No color, humanoids, new objects, morphing, holograms, glow, music, narration or generated text. Locked macro camera. The existing dark diaphragm deforms slightly under an unseen force and returns slowly. Only a thin reflected highlight reveals the movement. A quiet material creak, no extra object.
